functions.name: RotationMatrixToEuler
functions.summary: Extracts three Euler angles from a 3x3 row-major rotation matrix: writes the x-angle atan2(-a1[5], sqrt(a1[3]*a1[3] + a1[4]*a1[4])) to this+0, then branches on the FPU status flag (v2 & 0x4100) left by the sqrt. When the flag is set (near-zero cos component, gimbal lock), writes the y-angle atan2(-a1[6], a1[0]) to this+4 and zeroes this+8. Otherwise writes the y-angle atan2(a1[2], a1[8]) to this+4 and the z-angle atan2(a1[3], a1[4]) to this+8. Returns result = v2 & 0x4100 (non-zero when the singularity branch was taken).

Normal branch: writes the y-angle = atan2(a1[2], a1[8]) to this+4 and the z-angle = atan2(a1[3], a1[4]) to this+8
